title: Position 1 spectrum, sample-integrity and duplex preflight
goal: Establish sample ordering, observed spectral activity, coded-pilot detectability and timing behavior before attempting room inference.

ground_truth.prbs: Documented RX-internal 16-bit PRBS; analog path bypassed

environment: Attached stock TX/RX antennas on desk near computer, a few feet from router; operator nearby and may move. No measured antenna geometry or motion timestamps.
protocol: Three 2.4/5.8 GHz passive sweeps with lower-gain repeats on clipping
Fresh RX guard and TX-off baseline
Seven highly attenuated coded-pilot bursts at 5771.5 MHz
Independent TX-off negative control and mute verification
success_criteria: PRBS sequence valid at 5 MS/s and controlled loss detected at 7 MS/s
Reject intermittently active candidate on longer listen
Detect known pilot with no clipping or overflow within bounded RF bursts
Final RX settings restored; TX and BIST disabled
code_identity: Exact source snapshots and SHA-256 in each run
failures: One software attempt failed before TX unmute: libiio Buffer.write required bytearray. Fixed and retained.
Two 2.4 GHz sweep captures clipped at gain 40 dB; repeats at gain 20 dB did not clip.
7 MS/s deliberate overload produced three buffer-boundary PRBS skips.
uncertainties: Finite spectrum observation and uncalibrated antenna/receiver response
Actual radiated power and emissions unmeasured
PRBS errors spanning exactly a whole period may be invisible
Pilot includes direct coupling and unresolved multipath
Capture timing offsets arbitrary across restarts
Phase coherence across retunes and absolute hardware delay uncalibrated
No bearing observability from one fixed ordinary antenna pair
next_test: Reference-aligned channel measurement with a known scene change; do not infer a room outline from these preflight results.
